name: JTBD1 — Stale workbooks via list-workbooks
description: Stale-content JTBD via the REST list-workbooks path (not Admin Insights). Requires ADMIN_TOOLS_ENABLED=true and site-admin PAT. Model should filter list-workbooks on updatedAt before a cutoff (~90 days ago) to identify stale-workbook candidates. Read-only.
prompt: List the workbooks on this site that have not been updated recently (roughly the last 90 days) as stale-workbook candidates. Use the list-workbooks tool with an updatedAt filter. Report the workbook names and LUIDs and the cutoff date you used. Do not modify or delete anything.
